title: describing nonstationary data streams in frequency domain
core_idea: Introduce a frequency-filtering metadescriptor that characterizes nonstationary data streams by identifying informative frequency components in sample feature vectors, filtering them by variance across data batches to produce metadescriptions that separate data chunks into concept-specific groups and enable visualization in the original spatial domain.
tldr: A method that uses variance-filtered frequency components of feature vectors to create metadescriptions for characterizing and grouping concepts in nonstationary data streams, preserving semantic meaning while reducing dimensionality.
